ch8-salary-management.en: Let's set up a salary structure.
Open HR and Staff, then Salary. Each staff member needs a salary structure before payroll can be run.
Add an allowance, such as house rent, and a deduction, such as tax. The summary shows the net salary.
Set the date the salary starts from.
Save it, and Ali now appears in the salary list with his net pay.
ch8-setting-up-departments.en: Open HR and Staff, then Departments. Departments group your staff, such as Science or Administration.
Type the department name, and a short description if you like.
Press Add Department again to save, and the new department appears in the list.
ch8-staff-attendance.en: Open HR and Staff, then Attendance. The page opens on today, with every staff member unmarked.
Press Mark All Present for a full day.
Change Kamran to Late. Check-in times are optional.
Press Save All, and attendance is saved for every staff member.
Open the Summary tab to see each staff member's month: present, absent, late and the attendance rate.
ch8-staff-documents.en: Let's manage staff qualifications and documents.
Open HR and Staff, then Documents. There are two tabs: Qualifications and Documents.
On Qualifications, press Add Qualification and choose the staff member.
Choose the type, then enter the qualification name, the institution and the year.
Press Create, and the qualification is added to the list.
Open the Documents tab. It lists files such as contracts and ID cards. A yellow badge warns when a document is about to expire.
To add one, press Add Document, choose the staff member and type, give it a title and attach the file. The file is required.
ch9-converting-enquiries-to-students.en: Let's turn an enquiry into a student.
Only Confirmed enquiries can be converted. They have a checkbox.
Tick the enquiry, and a bar appears with Convert to students.
Choose the academic year, then the class and section.
Press Convert, and the student record and enrollment are created.
ch9-creating-enquiries.en: Let's record a new admission enquiry.
Open Admissions and Enquiries, then press New Enquiry.
Enter the student's name and the father's name.
Enter the mobile number, and choose the grade applied for.
Choose how the family found you, and add a note.
Press Create Enquiry, and it appears in the list with status New.
ch9-followup-management.en: Let's schedule a follow-up for an enquiry.
Find the family you need to call back.
Press Edit to open the enquiry.
Pick the next follow-up date, and write what was discussed.
Press Update Enquiry. The date now shows in the Follow-up column, in red once it is overdue.
ch9-managing-enquiries.en: The Admission funnel counts enquiries at each stage: New, Confirmed, Converted and Cancelled.
Click a stage to filter the list. Here, we see only New enquiries.
Search by the child's name or phone number.
When the family agrees, press Confirm, and the enquiry moves out of New.
If a family withdraws, search for them and press Cancel.
ch10-adding-vehicles.en: Open Transport and Vehicles, then press Add Vehicle.
Enter the number plate, then choose the type, the number of seats, and the make.
Enter the driver's name and phone, then choose the route this vehicle serves.
Press Add Vehicle, and it appears in the list with its driver and route.
ch10-assigning-students-to-routes.en: Let's assign students to a transport route.
Open Transport and Assignments, then press New Assignment.
Search for each student and click the name. You can add several students at once.
Choose the route, then the stop. The vehicle is optional.
Press Assign, and both students now appear in the list with their stop and times.
ch10-setting-up-routes.en: Let's set up a transport route.
Open Transport and Routes, then press Add Route.
Enter the route name, where it starts, where it ends, and the estimated minutes.
Press Create Route, and the route appears in the list.
Press Stops on the route, then Add Stop.
Name the stop, and set the pickup and drop times.
Press Add Stop, and the stop shows in the route with its order and times.
ch10-transport-attendance.en: Open Transport and Attendance. The date is today.
Choose the route. Its students are listed, all starting as Boarded.
Press Not Boarded for a student who missed the bus, or Absent for one at home.
Press Save All, and one record is saved for every student on the route for this day.
ch11-adding-books-to-the-catalog.en: Let's add books to the library catalog.
Open Library and Catalog, then press Add Book.
Enter the title and the author, both required, then the ISBN and the publisher.
Choose the category, set how many copies the library owns, and note the shelf location.
Press Add Book, and the new book appears in the catalog with every copy available.
Type part of a title, author or ISBN in the search box.
Clear the search and pick a category to browse one section of the library.
ch11-issuing-books.en: Open Library and Issue / Return. The Issue Book tab is ready.
Choose Student or Staff, type at least two letters of the name, and pick the person from the list.
Type part of the title. Only books with copies available are listed.
The due date is already set from the loan period, 14 days from today. Change it only if this loan is different.
Press Issue Book. It appears under Currently Issued Books, and the available copies drop by one.
